title: Projects
subtitle: Each project groups the skills, data sources and people for one area of work.
name: Project name
empty: Create your first project to start describing a task.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.subtitle: From an empty account to an agent that works from your skills.

provider.title: Choose an LLM provider
provider.body: Nothing generative runs until the server has one: interviews, drafts and the coach all answer no_llm_provider.

project.title: Create a project
project.body: Skills live inside a project, together with the people who work on them.

cli.title: Install the command line tool
cli.body: It is not on PyPI: this server distributes it. pipx keeps it in a virtualenv of its own, with no administrator rights.

device.title: Register the device
device.body: The command prints a code. Enter it here and approve: the machine then holds a key of its own, which you can revoke from My devices.

skill.title: Create the first skill
skill.body: Open a project and answer the interview: AutoSkill writes the skill from your answers, then hands your agent an address to install it from.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.subtitle: Keys let installed skills send run telemetry to this project.
apiKeys.name: Key name
apiKeys.created: Key created. Copy it now, it will not be shown again.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.confirm: Delete project "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
